summary: Completed testing of 8 bug fixes/changes for Zestbrains Company Portal. All backend tests passed (17/17). All frontend UI features verified working correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: Feature 1 (Refresh after weekend work): fetchPendingApprovals() is called in handleSubmit after successful weekend/holiday entry submission
Feature 2 (Date restriction): getMinDate() correctly calculates 2 days prior in IST timezone, date input has min/max attributes
Feature 3 (Delete rejected entries): DELETE /weekend-approvals/{id} endpoint exists and delete buttons visible in History tab
Feature 4 (Approve All): Button correctly shows only when pendingCount > 0, handleApproveAll iterates through all pending approvals
Feature 5 (Department filter): department_id parameter correctly filters in detailed-summary endpoint, checks both department_id and department_ids
Feature 6 (Half-day leave): leave_dates array with day_type (full/half) supported, calculateTotalDays() sums 0.5 for half days
Feature 7 (Dashboard leave boxes): /dashboard/employees-on-leave endpoint returns today/tomorrow arrays with day_type info
Feature 8 (Work report formatting): whitespace-pre-wrap CSS applied, work_details displayed with line breaks preserved
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 8 bug fixes verified working. Dashboard shows 2 employees on leave today (Reeman Saiyed, RKS) and 1 tomorrow (Reeman Saiyed - Half Day). No pending weekend approvals currently.

Feature 1 - Employee Refresh After Weeke.details: handleSubmit calls fetchPendingApprovals() after successful weekend/holiday entry. Pending approvals section refreshes automatically.

Feature 2 - Date Restriction to Last 2 D.details: Date input has min=2026-02-28, max=2026-03-02 (today). Helper text shows 'You can submit reports for today and up to 2 days prior'. getMinDate() function calculates correctly in IST.

Feature 3 - Admin Delete Rejected Entrie.details: History tab shows delete button (red trash icon) for approved/rejected entries. DELETE /weekend-approvals/{id} endpoint works correctly.

Feature 4 - Approve All Button.details: Approve All button correctly hidden when pendingCount=0. Button shows 'Approve All (N)' when pending entries exist. handleApproveAll iterates through all pending approvals.

Feature 5 - Department Filter in Working.details: Department dropdown shows all departments (HR, Android, UIUX, admin, IOS, PHP, WebDesign, PM, QA, React Native). Filter correctly filters employees by department_id or department_ids.

Feature 6 - Half-Day Leave Option.details: Leave Dates section with 'Add Date' button for multi-date selection. Each date has Full Day/Half Day dropdown. Total Days calculation shows '(Half days = 0.5, Full days = 1)'.

Feature 7 - Dashboard Leave Boxes.details: 'On Leave Today (2)' shows Reeman Saiyed (Full Day) and RKS (Full Day). 'On Leave Tomorrow (1)' shows Reeman Saiyed (Half Day). Boxes display correctly below stats.

Feature 8 - Work Report Formatting.details: Work Entry Details modal shows work_details with proper formatting. whitespace-pre-wrap CSS applied. Line breaks preserved in display.
